heroHeadline: Russia Warns All Diplomats to Flee Kyiv; Ukraine Drones Force Moscow Airspace Shutdown and First-Ever Kaliningrad 'Operation Carpet'
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,553, Russia issued an extraordinary ultimatum demanding all foreign diplomats and nationals leave Kyiv before promised 'systematic strikes' — which the EU, France, Poland, and other NATO allies flatly refused. Overnight May 25–26, Russia struck Kyiv with 2 ballistic missiles and 122 Shahed drones (111 intercepted), destroying one of Kyiv's oldest markets, killing 4 and wounding dozens; Mykolaiv high-rises and Sumy region were also hit. On May 27, Ukraine's long-range drone campaign hit a Voronezh military airfield, forced restrictions on Moscow's civilian airspace, and triggered 'Operation Carpet' flight restrictions at Kaliningrad's Khrabrovo airport for the first time since the war began. Pope Leo XIV condemned the 'sharp intensification' of Russia's war. ISW noted Ukrainian advances in western Zaporizhzhia Oblast and near Slovyansk. Russian cumulative losses reached approximately 1,358,950 personnel on Day 1,553; 65 attacks were recorded. Peace talks remain stalled as Russia demands full Donetsk Oblast recognition and Ukraine proposes a freeze along current frontlines.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, France 24, NPR, CNN, NBC News, PBS, The Moscow Times, CGTN, Newsweek, Yahoo News, Kyiv Post, Euromaidan Press, EMPR Media, CNBC, Semafor, CBC, Militarnyi, Euronews, and WBUR. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
